prompt: I need you to write a complex Python script with multiple async API calls and specific data transformations, but the sub-agent keeps failing with a timeout after 5 minutes. What now?
expected: Identify the error as a sub-agent timeout, retry once using the recovery pattern, then select a stronger capability tier or report an abort after repeated failures. Mention loading references/errors.md.

If the retry shows that the work exceeds the current tier, I will use the next available capability tier after checking runtime limits and cost. After repeated failures, I will stop retries and report the blocker with the recorded state.
bm25_prompt: delegate subagent timeout failure recovery async
